blocks.body:
Hi, my name is Sahil Sian (He/Him) and I'm an artist and software engineer from Surrey, BC. I paint en plein air and I have a strong interest in capturing temperature and mood while maintaining technical excellence.

I was born in 2001 in Surrey, BC. I started drawing as a child, making several portraits and colored pencil works. By the time I hit my teens, I was drawing as a streamer under the name "RuffyDrawz", creating multiple hyperrealistic works. As an adult, I started university at the British Columbia Institute of Technology, receiving a Digital Design and Development Diploma (2019 - 2021). I later attended Dalhousie University and graduated with a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science (2022 - 2026), and I currently work as a software developer in the financial industry.

Since graduating in April, I've spent my weekends painting from life en plein air. I might spend multiple sessions, even weeks, painting at the same place. I travel via transit, or by car if parking permits. I use a French easel, a U.Go field easel for mixing colors, and a series of Rosemary & Co brushes. My setup is compact enough for me to carry across long distances, yet heavy enough that it feels like a workout. Perfect balance!

I absolutely love painting. If you have any questions about my process, feel free to reach out to me on [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/sahilcyan/).
